feature_title: Agent Profile Feedback Loop - Bounded Submission & Append-Only Feedback-Record Boundary

0046-01.01.scope: feedback UX/API validation and target/baseline preview

0046-01.02.scope: append-only feedback journal, identity/anonymous policy, idempotency and retention

invariants_verified.bounded: Strict field limits (feedback_text max 4000, agent name max 64, baseline max 128), schema validation, and injection-safe HTML/JSON rendering.
invariants_verified.idempotent: Digest-based SHA-256 idempotency key generated per payload; duplicate submissions detected and rejected across restarts.
invariants_verified.append_only: Feedback journal is strictly append-only; updates/redactions are recorded as additive retention events without historical deletion.
invariants_verified.privacy_metadata: Explicit identified vs anonymous attribution support; visibility consent levels (private/team/public); anonymous submissions enforce no approval authority per DEC-0046-001 Option A.
invariants_verified.zero_authoritative_mutation: Ingress and journal boundaries do not mutate agent profiles, supervisor configurations, or deployment state.
